findings.problem: The mark box (left 95.14%, top 16.83%, about 50x50 px at x 1370-1420, y 101-151) does sit on the round stamp, so the name is right. But the bullet list below calls this control {ui:minipanel.doctrine.apply_policies} ('Apply these lexes'), and the caption never uses that name. A reader may not link 'apply stamp' in the caption to 'Apply these lexes' in the list.
findings.fix: Name it after the UI string in the caption, e.g. 'the Apply these lexes stamp (3)', or change the bullet to 'The apply stamp ({ui:minipanel.doctrine.apply_policies}) applies your picks.' so both use the same name.

findings.claim: 'While you have a change picked, the lex panel shows the wait applying now would start, as in the lex panel screenshot below.'
findings.problem: The 'as in the lex panel screenshot below' clause points at the page layout and pads the sentence (21 words). Mark 4 in the lex-panel shot already shows that header line ('Applying now locks your lexes for 30min'), and its caption names it.
findings.fix: Shorten to 'While you have a change picked, the lex panel shows the wait applying now would start.' If the pointer stays, use a link to the section instead, e.g. 'See [[lexes#the-lex-panel]]'.

findings.claim: The sentence in 'Changing your active lexes' points to 'the lex panel screenshot below' but the screenshot sits two sections later.
findings.problem: A 'below' pointer across sections is fragile, and the reader meets the wait line before the image that shows it.
findings.fix: Either drop 'as in the lex panel screenshot below' (mark 4 in the lex panel caption already names the wait), or move a small lex-panel-wait or lex-panel shot next to that sentence.

findings.claim: The lex panel section's bullets still describe buttons the new shot shows, such as +1 slot, Cancel the changes and Remove all lexes.
findings.problem: The lex-panel shot has unused marks (slots, buy-slot). The +1 slot bullet and the slots counter are visible in the image but neither is numbered nor captioned.
findings.fix: Optionally add buy-slot (and slots) to the marks and caption, e.g. '...the lex slots (4) with +1 slot (5)...', or leave as is. The bullets carry behavior (no confirm, second click), so keeping them is defensible.

findings.claim: The lex-card shot follows the Buy and Activate paragraph but the plain Buy button is not mentioned in the text before it.
findings.problem: Mark 1 (Buy) is introduced only by the caption, while the click-to-buy behavior is explained later in the panel bullets. This is a minor ordering issue, not a wrong mark.
findings.fix: None needed. If desired, move the shot up one paragraph so it follows 'You need the lex's ancestor and enough ideology'.
